## 1. Codex

### 1.1. Token costs (credits per 1M tokens)

::: {.cost-table}

+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Model (`codex -m`)             | Input    | Cached     | Output   | Burn: in   | Burn: cached | Burn: out  |
+================================+==========+============+==========+============+==============+============+
| `gpt-6-luna`                   | 2.5      | 0.25       | 12.5     | 1×         | 1×           | 1×         |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| `gpt-6.1-terra`                | 25       | 1.25       | 125      | 10×        | 5×           | 10×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| `gpt-6-sol`                    | 50       | 5          | 250      | 20×        | 20×          | 20×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| `gpt-6.1-sol`                  | 50       | 2.5        | 250      | 20×        | 10×          | 20×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| `gpt-6.2-sol`                  | 50       | 2.5        | 250      | 20×        | 10×          | 20×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| `gpt-6.2-astra`                | 200      | 10         | 1,000    | 80×        | 40×          | 80×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| `gpt-6-astra`                  | 250      | 25         | 1,250    | 100×       | 100×         | 100×       |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+

:::

::: {.table-notes}

**Columns:** 1M = one million tokens.
**Input** = new, uncached prompt/context tokens, including history and tool results.
**Cached** = input tokens reused from a stored prompt prefix.
**Output** = generated tokens, including billed reasoning/thinking tokens.

**Burn: in / cached / out** = row rate ÷ GPT-6 Luna rate in the corresponding column.
Ratios are calculated here; credits and USD are not directly comparable.

**Billing:** [Standard-speed Codex credit rates][cp]; no cache-write charge.
API-key usage follows API pricing; credits alone do not determine included subscription usage.
Fast: 2× credits; included usage is 2× for GPT-6.2, 2.5× for older models.
GPT-6.2 Ultrafast: 6× included usage; purchased credits/PAYG 3× through 2027-02-28, then 6× from 2027-03-01 (Pacific time).

:::

## 2. Claude Code

### 2.1. Token costs (USD per 1M tokens)

::: {.cost-table}

+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Model (`/model`)               | Input    | Cache hit  | Output   | Burn: in   | Burn: cached | Burn: out  |
+================================+==========+============+==========+============+==============+============+
| Haiku 5.5 (`haiku`)            | $0.10    | $0.01      | $0.50    | 1×         | 1×           | 1×         |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Sonnet 5.5 (`sonnet`)          | $2       | $0.10      | $10      | 20×        | 10×          | 20×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Opus 5.5 (`opus`)              | $4       | $0.20      | $20      | 40×        | 20×          | 40×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Opus 5.5 fast (`/fast`)        | $8       | $0.40      | $40      | 80×        | 40×          | 80×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Fable 5.2 (`fable`)            | $8       | $0.20      | $40      | 80×        | 20×          | 80×        |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Fable 5.1                      | $10      | $0.25      | $50      | 100×       | 25×          | 100×       |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+
| Fable 5.2 fast (`/fast`)       | $16      | $0.40      | $80      | 160×       | 40×          | 160×       |
+--------------------------------+----------+------------+----------+------------+--------------+------------+

:::

::: {.table-notes}

**Columns:** 1M = one million tokens.
**Input** = new, uncached prompt/context tokens, including history and tool results.
**Cache hit** = input tokens reused from a stored prompt prefix.
**Output** = generated tokens, including billed reasoning/thinking tokens.

**Burn: in / cached / out** = row rate ÷ Haiku 5.5 rate in the corresponding column.
Ratios are calculated here; credits and USD are not directly comparable.

**Billing:** [Anthropic API rates][ap].
Cache writes cost 1.25× input (5m) or 2× input (1h).
Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K tokens cost 5× all rates.
Subscription [fast mode][cf] uses usage credits.
Fast rows use the same base model; release dates and descriptions below also apply to them.

:::

::: {.table-notes}

**Sources:** linked Anthropic model overviews provide release dates; descriptions quote linked official excerpts.

**CLI aliases:** [targets vary by version/provider][cc].
Minimum versions: Haiku 5.5 2.1.293; Sonnet 5.5 2.1.284; Opus 5.5 2.1.280; Fable 5.2 2.1.321.
Fable 5.1: select `/model claude-fable-5-1` (2.1.257+).
`opusplan` uses Opus for planning and Sonnet for execution.

:::
